outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map combined with western blot images, not a plot requiring individual data points.

Bar charts showing % HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance derived from single densitometry measurements of the blots in panel A, not averages across replicates, so individual points are not applicable.
Heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Violin plots already display the full distribution of the underlying data, so individual points are not required.
Bar charts show mean ± SD (n = 4) for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1 abundance, with individual data points (circles) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted crystal structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatterplots comparing enrichment ratios; scatter plots inherently display individual data points.
Scatterplot of HTT vs HAP40 abundance for individual IP-MS experiments; scatter plots are exempt as they already show individual points.
PCA scatterplot; each point already represents an individual sample, so no additional overlay is needed.
PCA scatterplots stratified by antibody set/tissue; each point already represents an individual sample, so no additional overlay is needed.
